description: A very sharp thin-bladed knife used to shave the edge of paper or a plate down to a feathered thinness. Drawing the edge along a surface raises a burr that lets the blade skim almost flat while removing a fine shaving.
name: paring knife

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter III, p.53. Internet Archive.
